notes.notes:

[h3][b]Pre-sale Giveaways[/b][/h3]

But if you're in the mood for something a little different, check out Accident - a game all about puzzle-solving car crashes. It's on a -50% discount and is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end.

And last but not least, don't miss out on Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment, which is on a -30% discount. This game is a must-have for any fan of science fiction and is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat.

Don't miss out on these amazing deals during the Steam Winter Sale. Stock up on all your favorite games and save big while you can!

notes.title: Barn Finders launches on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation & Xbox on June 17!
notes.notes:
Howdy y’all!

Have you ever wondered: “Man, I’d love to sell precious treasures from the comfort of my very own couch”? Welp, we know you do, cause you were askin’ for it, and boy, oh boy, we delivered! 

Barn Finders launches on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation & Xbox on June 17 🎮🎉! 
Jump into your ood & beloved world of Ameryka filled with barns 🐔, garbage 🗑, and special guests 👽 from the comfort of your couch! 

Check out the announcement trailer here!

[previewyoutube=ezB47nXrju0;full][/previewyoutube]

We simply can’t wait for you to try out Barn Finders on consoles and are thrilled to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Barn Finders VR is out now!
notes.notes:

We’re introducing bundles which feature games like: House Flipper VR, Ultimate Fishing Simulator VR & Car Mechanic Simulator VR! 
You can pick them all now with discounted price in a bundle, if you own any game that’s in it! 

Join us on our Discord - https://discord.gg/wKE9FtQs! And don’t miss any giveaways!
